title: SOS/confessions: monotonic uptime time source by default
description: Gap 4 of a6qg: rate-limiting time source defaults to wall-clock time.time in SosResource and ConfessionsResource (also SosRelay); spec 18.4.1/18.10.3 require monotonic uptime. time_func is injectable but production wiring passes none. Fix: default constructors to time.monotonic. Update green doc tests test_time_source_defaults_to_wall_clock_today (SOS line ~761 and confessions line ~1048). Run FULL python suite for fallout.
notes: SRC SIDE DONE (worker2, branch beads-worker-2): SosResource and ConfessionsResource time_func defaults changed time.time -> time.monotonic (injectable params kept). SosRelay default was already flipped to time.monotonic by a prior uncommitted working-copy change to python/src/lichen/coap/sos_relay.py (not mine). Stage 2: update green doc tests test_time_source_defaults_to_wall_clock_today in both test files (SOS ~line 761, confessions ~line 1048) to assert time.monotonic; note prior pass's uncommitted edits to test/vectors/sos_signature.json + sos_rate_limiting.json + sos_relay.py already flipped test_canonical_cbor_*_exact_pin (XPASS-strict) and test_origin_sequence_rollback_live_behavior independent of this work.
close_reason: Rate-limiting time source defaults to monotonic uptime: SosResource and ConfessionsResource constructors default time_func to time.monotonic (src changes were present uncommitted in this worktree from prior pass). Fixed broken SosRelay default from prior pass: field(default_factory=time.monotonic) stored the RESULT of time.monotonic() (a float) instead of the callable, breaking all SosRelay() constructions with TypeError; corrected to field(default_factory=lambda: time.monotonic). Green doc tests test_time_source_defaults_to_wall_clock_today renamed to test_time_source_defaults_to_monotonic_uptime in test_security_app_vector_consumers.py (SOS + confessions), asserting time.monotonic. FULL suite: 8129 passed, 247 skipped, 14 xfailed; 4 pre-existing unrelated failures (test_lci_auth location method-not-allowed, 3 sim/radio delayed-rx tests) verified pre-existing by reproducing with the change reverted.
